notes: The portable C++ TCK checks the standard evoked ownership-acquisition cancellation race against owner denial. An adapter supplies the provider library, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. The scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ API and the C++ standard library, verifies one tagged Attribute Ownership Unavailable reply with no stale cancellation confirmation, and checks that ownership remains with the owner. This is public-API evidence for the second losing-cancellation reply form in clause 7.15, not proof of the aggregate three-form reply rule or general conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, and attributeOwnershipReleaseDenied with standard ownership callbacks
